name: GLP-1 daily monitoring
description: Daily symptom check-in with safety screening for patients on GLP-1 receptor agonists and related incretin therapies.
governance_note: Thresholds, patient-facing wording and escalation rules in this file have not been reviewed or approved by a licensed clinician. They must be signed off before use with patients.
